headline: Public hearing and decision on demolition delay application for 121 Bridge Street, Beverly.
summary: The meeting includes a public hearing and decision on a demolition delay for 121 Bridge Street. It also covers a change to an approved demolition delay at 824 Hale Street and a construction management plan for the Beverly City Hall renovation at 191 Cabot Street.
items: Public hearing: Demolition Delay Application (DD-26-11), 121 Bridge Street, Beverly, MA, c/o Tomasz Wabno
Discussion and decision: Demolition Delay Application (DD-26-11), 121 Bridge Street, Beverly, MA, c/o Tomasz Wabno
Discussion: Modification to approved Demolition Delay (DD-25-12), 824 Hale Street, c/o John Harden, architect
Discussion: Construction Management Plan for Abbott Street Cemetery, Beverly City Hall Renovation Project, 191 Cabot Street, c/o Diego Corona, W.T. Rich
Administrative approvals, not discussed at this meeting: Demolition Delay Not Applicable for 140 Essex Street, 16 Gove Avenue, and 45 Cole Street

Project and committee updates: Prospect Hill Walking Tour and Powder House events recap, and Powder House signage; Cabot-Rantoul Residential Neighborhood historic resource survey update; Demolition Delay Ordinance Amendment status; Community Preservation Committee update; Design Review Board update
New business, other business, or topics for future agendas, if any
